title: fix(mcp): render the /mcp/skill data loop from the published objectstack-ask skill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34686

This is the second half of the card: the data-loop text of `GET /mcp/skill` is now rendered from the published ask-data skill (`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, landed by #34685 as `581c9165`), and a test pins the two equal. The first half (the HTTP `initialize` instructions) landed as #34790 (`c513d62a`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`/mcp/skill` 页面里"问数"那段流程不再手写，改为由脚本从已发布的 `objectstack-ask` 技能正文生成进 `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts`，页面在新小节 "Answering a business question" 下原样输出；两个数据集工具条目只留签名和返回内容一句话。
- **为什么改**：手写版已经和技能文字分叉(例如 `membersWithheld` 的说法、松散词要先反问、两个词各命中一个指标要都算)。卡片要求单一来源，并用测试钉住两者相等。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响带数据集工具且凭据有 `data:read`(或无 scope)的页面，其他宿主和凭据的页面逐字节不变。全量宿主页面从 16,623 增至 20,272 字节。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。范围外文件：`turbo.json` 加两行测试输入(门禁强制)；修复轮 1 在 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` 加一行分类(修 CI 的 PM dispatch-gates 自测)。
- **先看**：`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`(`datasetToolsTaught` 门与 `renderAskSection` 插入位置)、`scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs`(截取规则：技能 H1 标题之后的全部正文)、`packages/mcp/src/skill-single-source-34686.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/skill-single-source-34686.test.ts`，预期 3 个测试全绿；改技能里任意一个词再跑，预期 2 个转红。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Mechanism (measured, then chosen).** A generated module committed in the package, held equal to the skill by a test:
  - `scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs` writes `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts` (`ASK_SKILL_DATA_LOOP`, one string) from `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`. `--check` exits 1 when the module is stale or missing, and writes nothing.
  - Why not a read of the skill at run time: `@objectstack/mcp` ships only `dist`, README and CHANGELOG (`files[]`), so `skills/**` is not on disk in an installed package; and `@objectstack/skills` exports only `./package.json`, so a runtime dependency on it would mean a filesystem read of another package's build output on every host. Not chosen.
  - Why not a bundler inline (an esbuild text loader importing the `.md`): turbo hashes `@objectstack/mcp#build` from the package directory plus the root scripts `turbo.json` lists (`build.inputs` is `$TURBO_DEFAULT$` plus those), and `skills/**` is not among them. A skill-only edit would replay a cached `dist` carrying the old text. It would also need a tsup config change, a `*.md` module declaration for `tsc`, and a vitest loader. Not chosen.
  - A module under `src/` is hashed with the package, ships in its `dist` (measured: the section heading and the skill's sentence "One near form is not a match either" are in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp build`), and the pin test goes red on any difference.
- **Which part of the skill is the data loop.** The skill's body after its title: every line after its one H1 (`# Answering a business question over an ObjectStack environment`), with blank lines at either end dropped. That is the intro paragraph and steps 1 to 6 (lift the words, decide by the matches with the step 2 table, compute, fall back, when the data cannot answer, writing the answer). The frontmatter and the title stay with the skill. The served page gives the text its own heading, `## Answering a business question` (`ASK_SECTION_HEADING`), and copies the rest byte for byte, the skill's `##` step headings included.
- **What stays served-page prose.** The two entries in the page's tool list, `list_datasets({ terms? })` and `query_dataset({ datasetName, selection })`, keep a one-sentence description of what each answer carries and point to the section. Every rule (selection, `membersWithheld`, fallback, data that cannot answer) now comes only from the skill.
- **Gate unchanged.** `datasetToolsTaught` is the condition `renderDatasetToolLines` held inline: `datasetTools === true` AND (no scopes OR scopes include `data:read`). Both the tool entries and the section render only under it. The section is placed after every other block of the tool list (file, dataset, federation, authoring, data-only) and before `## Conventions & gotchas`, so a render that does not teach the pair is byte-identical to before. The route `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` is unchanged.
- **Comment fix** in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`: the `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` doc comment pointed at `DATASET_TOOL_LINES` as holding "the same thing". It now points at `ASK_SKILL_DATA_LOOP` and states where the skill goes further. No code change there.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/34686-skill-single-source.md`: `@objectstack/mcp` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### Old served text vs new (every divergence found)

Old = `DATASET_TOOL_LINES` at `7752cac7` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts:265-292`). New = the skill, as now served.

1. **`membersWithheld`.** Old: "some measures exist that you may not read: say so rather than saying the metric does not exist." New: "Say that it has members (measures or groupings) you may not read; the metric asked for may be among them. Do not say the metric does not exist."
2. **Row 1, one match per word.** Old: "One measure match: answer with `query_dataset`." New: "Each word for a thing measured matches exactly one measure: compute. Two words with one measure each ("营收和赢单率") are two metrics, not a choice: compute both, with one `query_dataset` per dataset."
3. **Row 2, several matches.** Old: "Several matches (two datasets or two members): ask the user …; do not pick." That read as asking whenever the answer held more than one match. New: "One word matches several measures, in one dataset or in two: ask …". Several matches across different words are row 1 (compute both).
4. **Loose-form row (new).** Old: no match always fell back. New: "Nothing matches, and the word is a loose form of several listed measures: ask the user which one they mean … Do not pick one, and compute nothing yet", plus the paragraph defining a loose form ("revenue" against Won Revenue, Annual Revenue and Planned Revenue).
5. **"One near form is not a match either: it selects nothing" (new),** on the fallback row.
6. **Dimension-only row.** Old: "A dimension match alone … is not an answer: you still need a measure match, or ask." New: "That is a grouping ("by stage"), not a number. You still need a measure match; without one, ask which number is meant." Same meaning.
7. **Terms.** New: pass the words "as the user wrote them and in the user's language. Do not translate or reword a term". Old said only "the business words of the question".
8. **Asking.** New: "the reply is the question alone: no figure, and no tool call until the user answers"; `partial: true` / `warning` on the catalogue are explained. Old had neither.
9. **`query_dataset`.** Old named `measures`, `dimensions`, `runtimeFilter`. New adds `dateGranularity`, `order`, `limit`, and `truncated` / `warning` handling. Provenance and description use are the same.
10. **Fallback.** Old: "fall back to `query_records` / `aggregate_records` and say the answer is not from a governed metric." New (step 4): `list_objects` then `describe_object`, filter an option field by its `value`, use `aggregate_records` and never add up pages of `query_records`, open with one line saying it is not from a governed metric (非指标口径) naming the object and fields, and add one line naming a listed dataset on that object (ADR-0149 D3 rule 4's recommended practice; the old page did not carry it).
11. **When the data cannot answer.** Old: "… Never fill the gap with an assumed value, nor draw a conclusion from one ("under a typical term, none would…"). Any figure you add comes from a tool answer; cite it." New (step 5): "Never fill the gap with an assumed value, and never draw a conclusion from one." The quoted example is gone, and "Any figure … cite it" becomes step 6's "Every figure comes from a tool answer in this conversation."
12. **Writing the answer (new, step 6):** the user's language, labels rather than machine names or raw option values, the filter and time window stated in words.
13. **Intro (new):** "Never skip step 1: a governed metric … outranks a number you work out yourself." The skill's line "No `list_datasets` among your tools: … Go to step 4" is served too. On this page it never applies, because the section renders only where `list_datasets` is registered. It is kept so the copy stays exact.

### `/mcp/skill` size, bytes (UTF-8)

In-process `renderSkillMarkdown` with `mcpUrl: 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/mcp'`, no `grantedScopes` (what the public route passes for every caller, admin included):

| Host carries | Before (`7752cac7`) | After (`e8dd0048`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| file tools + new-record upload links + dataset tools | 16,623 | 20,272 |
| file tools + dataset tools | 15,943 | 19,592 |
| dataset tools only | 14,859 | 18,508 |
| file tools + new-record upload links, no dataset tools | 14,707 | 14,707 |
| file tools, no dataset tools | 14,027 | 14,027 |
| none | 12,943 | 12,943 |

The first row is the card's `examples/app-crm` reading. The card measured 16,625 with a five-digit port, which adds one byte to each of the URL's two occurrences. After, with grants: `data:read` 19,031; `data:write` 14,184; `metadata:write` 12,943 (no dataset text in the last two).

## Tests

- **New `packages/mcp/src/skill-single-source-34686.test.ts`, 3 tests.** It reads `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` and takes its data loop by the generator's rule. (1) `ASK_SKILL_DATA_LOOP` equals it. (2) The section `renderSkillMarkdown` serves under `ASK_SECTION_HEADING` equals it, for four renders: unscoped, a full host with a URL, `data:read`, and `data:read` + `metadata:write` with an authoring tool. (3) The gate still drops it: `data:write`, `metadata:write`, an empty grant, no `datasetTools`, and `datasetTools: false` with `data:read` each render no section, no step heading and no `list_datasets`. The failure text says to run `node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs`.
- **`packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`, two tests rewritten.** "renders the rule…" asserted the old prose ('Choosing between a metric and an object query', 'nor draw a conclusion from one', 'Any figure you add comes from a tool answer; cite it.'). Those words are now the skill's, and the new file pins the whole section byte-equal to it. The two tests now assert the section heading is present, sits after `**query_dataset(` and before the conventions, and is absent without the pair. The third test (the `data:read` gate on `list_datasets`) is unchanged.
- The Console mirror pin (`skill-md.test.ts`, `renderObjectStackSkill(options) === renderSkillMarkdown(options)`) and the native-surface drift guard (`skill-md-surface-guard.test.ts`) pass unchanged. The mirror renders no dataset text, so the Console copy (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`) needs no edit.

<details><summary>Test runs (head e8dd0048 unless stated)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` (under the shared verify lock): `Test Files 70 passed (70)`, `Tests 1244 passed (1244)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` at `29cd2d0e` (the second commit touches only `turbo.json` and the registry): `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, then `check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/mcp's test layer compiles under packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json; 6 file(s) / 53 error(s) / 8 pinned signature(s) held` (debt unchanged), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs --check`: `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts is current with skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md.`, exit 0. Before the module existed, the same command printed `is missing … Run: node scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs` and exited 1.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp build`: `check-dts-emitted: @objectstack/mcp - 2/2 declared declaration file(s) present.`

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, at 29cd2d0e)</summary>

One word of the skill, in the worktree only: anchor `outranks a number you work out yourself` was replaced by `outranks a number you compute yourself`. Output: `anchor x1 -> x0`, `replace x0 -> x1`, `blob 482410fbd632 -> 7e726754f3fa`. Then `× the generated module equals the skill's data loop`, `× the served section equals the skill's data loop, for every grant that is taught the dataset pair`, `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`. Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (482410fbd632) and git diff HEAD is empty`. `git hash-object` of the file and `HEAD:skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` were both `482410fbd632e8e09f9e1d88017906f35d58fc4a` afterwards. No `dist/` is involved: the test imports the module from source and reads the skill from disk.

</details>

## Outside the claimed surface

The claim's PR2 surface is `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`, new modules and tests in `packages/mcp/src/`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (not touched), `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `.changeset/`. Outside it:

- `scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs`: new, the generator. No `package.json` script was added. A `gen:` script would enter the generator ledger that `git-merge-regen.mjs` reconciles; the pin test already fails in CI on drift.
- `turbo.json`: two lines added to `@objectstack/mcp#test` inputs (`$TURBO_ROOT$/skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, `$TURBO_ROOT$/scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs`). `check:cross-package-test-inputs` requires every glob declared in the registry to be mirrored there. Without them it is red: `turbo.json "@objectstack/mcp#test" inputs are missing the declared glob(s): $TURBO_ROOT$/skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`. The generator is declared because the test names it in its failure text, and the gate flagged it as `named in packages/mcp/src/skill-single-source-34686.test.ts`.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`: doc comment only, see What changes.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`: an existing test file, see Tests.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`: one `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` row and its doc paragraph (fix round 1, below).

## Acceptance notes

- **`DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` vs the skill.** This is the `initialize` rule from #34790, at `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:1813-1818` on this head. Not changed here. It says "Several matches: ask the user which one they mean" and "No match: fall back to query_records / aggregate_records". The skill (`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md:48`, `:51`) computes two metrics when two words each match one measure, and asks before falling back when a word with no match is a loose form of several listed measures. The `list_datasets` tool description (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts:85-96`) carries the same text as the rule, and ADR-0149 D3's amendment names #34763 as the carrier for the tool descriptions' question-before-fallback branch. Changing only the instructions here would make them disagree with the tool description instead. This is left to the seat (see the report).
- The section serves the skill's line "No `list_datasets` among your tools … Go to step 4" on a page that only renders where `list_datasets` is registered. It is inert there and kept for exactness.
- The skill's step headings are served as `##`, siblings of the page's own `##` sections. They are not demoted, because a transform would make the copy no longer the skill's bytes.

## Verification

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 84 families at `29cd2d0e` and 85 at `e8dd0048` (`+ pnpm check:turbo-task-graph` for `turbo.json`). All were run locally. Reconciliation `--ran` with exit codes: `85 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
  - `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` was red at `29cd2d0e` (the two findings quoted above). After the `turbo.json` and registry commit: `OK: 32 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared, and turbo.json hashes every declared glob`.
  - `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity` and `pnpm check:turbo-task-graph` were re-run after that commit: both OK.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/` (48 unbuilt packages outside this diff's closure). It runs in CI's Lint & Repo Gates.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-34686-skill-single-source`: `0 of 9 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed`, 465 changed lines.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` on `e8dd0048`: `origin/main: merges cleanly`, `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
- Lint of the changed files (`pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the seven code files): exit 0. The repo-wide lint is CI's.

## Fix round 1

CI on `e8dd0048` was red on `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (and so on `Lint & Repo Gates`) with one self-test case: `every structural read of a GOVERNED file under scripts/ is classified in GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR — unpinned: scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs::skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, `1 of 2217 case(s) failed`. Reproduced locally with `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: the same single failure.

- **Fix (`4a78d86b`):** one row in `GOVERNED_READ_FLOOR` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`), `{ script: 'scripts/gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs', file: 'skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md', declared: false }`, with an "eighth row" doc paragraph. `declared` is false because the floor reads it off a `self-test-reads` line, and the generator has no self-test; it spells the skill path in its module body, the shape of the `check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` row. The case `each pinned row's DECLARED flag still reads off the file` passes, so the flag is the live one.
- **No gate family runs the generator**, so the census case `every governed read in the census is DERIVED for the file it reads` has no family to place it under (it passes: `none underived`). Nothing new was declared. A change to `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` alone derives 27 families (for example `check:skill-docs`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`), and none of them is `gen-mcp-ask-skill.mjs --check`. What re-runs on such a change is the `@objectstack/mcp` test suite (Test Core), through the `turbo.json` input and the `cross-package-test-inputs` row added earlier in this PR, and its `skill-single-source-34686.test.ts` fails on drift and names the generator.
- **After the fix:** `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0, `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 2217 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred.`
- `check-governed-merges --branch`: `0 of 10 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed`, 482 changed lines. The branch merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`fc5913e1`), so it was not merged. `overlap-check` on `4a78d86b`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (it shares `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` with #34893 and #34841, and both merge cleanly). A first run had answered exit 3 (`files of #34837 unreadable`) and the re-run answered clean.

<details><summary>Gates for this round</summary>

The 63 families derived for `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs` were run locally on `4a78d86b`: 62 exit 0, and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt `dist/`), so it is NOT MEASURED here. `--ran` over the whole branch: `115 derived, 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 52 UNRUN`. The 52 unrun are derived from this PR's earlier files, which this round did not change. On `e8dd0048` every check-run but the two above was success or skipped.

</details>
